title: Enhancing cervical squamous cell carcinoma diagnosis under distribution shift via domain-adaptive representation learning

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Enhancing cervical squamous cell carcinoma diagnosis under distribution shift via domain-adaptive representation learning》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Automated whole-slide image (WSI) analysis for cervical squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC) is challenged by limited pathological specificity in general models and poor cross-center generalization.

evidence.text: Automated whole-slide image (WSI) analysis for cervical squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC) is challenged by limited pathological specificity in general models and poor cross-center generalization.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Enhancing cervical squamous cell carcinoma diagnosis under distribution shift via domain-adaptive representation learning》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We propose CSCC-PAG (pre-training, adaptation, generalization), a framework integrating domain-specific pre-training with self-supervised domain adaptation.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Utilizing 8,041 CSCC WSIs, we applied the self-supervised pre-training for CSCC (SPC) feature extractor, which significantly outperforms pan-cancer baselines in the typing, grading, and segmentation tasks.

evidence.text: We propose CSCC-PAG (pre-training, adaptation, generalization), a framework integrating domain-specific pre-training with self-supervised domain adaptation.

Utilizing 8,041 CSCC WSIs, we applied the self-supervised pre-training for CSCC (SPC) feature extractor, which significantly outperforms pan-cancer baselines in the typing, grading, and segmentation tasks.
